unitFixtureGeneration.reason: Direct libaom AV1 -> WebM fixture encoding failed before tests. Generate delayed-moov MP4, then copy real AV1 packets into WebM; final normal and ASan/UBSan suites both pass all four tests.

limitations: Separate AV1 video and Opus audio WebM only; Main 8/10-bit 4:2:0, known VOD duration, DefaultDuration video, known-size clusters, no lacing/encryption
Initial AV1 key TU requires matching Sequence Header and one Frame OBU; scalable layers and arbitrary payload integrity are not qualified
Native Opus mono/stereo coverage; new end-to-end AV1 WebM corpus uses Opus stereo
Qt verifies active audio codec/rate and changing decoded frames; Classic verifies graph/status and decoder reads without optical/physical output measurement
No physical A/V synchronization, 30-minute drift, HDR/10-bit final Qt surface or 4K realtime qualification
Mixed MP4/WebM, VP8/Vorbis, arbitrary MKV/Ogg, muxed/remux, segments/live, metadata and real Harvester integration remain outstanding
Installed Windows EXE/profiles unchanged; hardware and Wayland excluded; YouTubeHarvester unchanged
